I can't answer the campaign response, consent or uplift parts of your question, and I can't send the spring promotion. What the data does support is a list of your top customers by invoiced sales, shown below.

**Source:** the released product **DAILY_INVOICED_SALES**, version **101**, read from `HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.L2P_RELEASE.DAILY_INVOICED_SALES_V0101`. It covers invoices from 2026-01-05 to 2026-03-03.

**What I can't answer:**
- **Who responded best to the last campaign:** the product has no campaign or response data.
- **Who has marketing consent:** there's no consent data, so this list doesn't show who you're allowed to contact.
- **What uplift to expect:** there's no data on what a campaign actually caused, so I can't give an estimate.
- **Profitability:** there's no margin data either, so higher sales here doesn't mean a customer is more profitable.
- **Sending the spring promotion:** I can't send campaigns, schedule anything or contact customers.
